note: Use a globally longest trail. To handle repeated endpoint visits rigorously, orient each used edge in traversal direction: at distinct initial/terminal vertices, departures-arrivals are +1/-1, so used degree is odd at both. Even full degree then forces an unused incident edge. Once closed, any omitted edge yields an omitted edge incident with the trail, directly or via the first edge leaving its vertex set along a connectivity path. Rotate the closed trail at that incidence vertex and append.
